title: Cold rebuild: Org cost
summary: Rebuild Org cost from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Org cost** in *Recursive CTEs*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

code: SELECT x * 2 FROM n WHERE x < 20
steps.explain: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16. Then 16 < 20 lets one more step run and produce 32; 32 fails the test, so the next step is empty.

steps.title: Rebuild Org cost cold
prompt: For each of the CEO's **direct reports**, return their **name** and the **total salary** of their whole organisation including themselves (**org_salary**), highest first.
Tables: `employees(id, name, title, team, manager_id, salary)`; `manager_id` points at another employee (NULL for the CEO).
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
